create.name: Charleene Closshey
create.bio:
Charleene Closshey is a composer and sound teacher who plays a full twelve-note set of crystal singing bowls. Her first career was in classical and stage music: she trained at Juilliard and Berklee, played violin and acted in the Broadway company of the musical Once, and had a single on the Billboard adult contemporary chart. After her father died she found she could no longer play or sing, and it was sitting with a handful of crystal bowls that slowly brought her back to music. That experience became the root of her present work.

From her studio in Plant City, Florida, she leads free live sound bath meditations that follow the moon, the solstices and the seasons, and she records guided sleep and heart meditations for her YouTube channel. Her paid programmes, such as Heart Alchemy and The Hypnotic Heart, combine short teachings with listening practices aimed at calm, presence and a steadier inner rhythm. She is a doctoral student researching how listeners respond to music, and she encourages people to notice for themselves what a sound does rather than taking anyone's word for it. She also teaches sound courses through The Shift Network and is writing a book on what she calls the Archetypes of Sound.

courses.title: Heart Alchemy
courses.description: A self-paced programme of recorded lectures, guided listening sessions and frequency music tracks centred on the heart. Students weave the music into a daily practice meant to settle the mind and bring feeling and thought into step. The Hypnotic Heart session series is included as a bonus.
courses.price: $432 USD or 3 monthly instalments of $158 USD

courses.title: The Hypnotic Heart
courses.description: A sequence of twelve recorded sessions that pair live crystal bowl music with guided inner journeys, taken one after another at your own pace. Each session builds on the one before, moving from inner quiet towards heart-centred intention. Enrolment is open at any time.

courses.title: Frequency Optimized Living Masterclass Series
courses.description: Three recorded masterclasses for sound practitioners and curious listeners on how frequency and music are thought to work, each with a teaching, a live sound experience and questions. The first class is free on demand.
courses.price: Class 1 free; classes 2 and 3 $19 USD each or $29 USD together

free_resources.title: Free Live Sound Bath Meditations
free_resources.description: Regular free live sound baths on crystal singing bowls, each built around a theme such as a full moon, a solstice or a season. Past sessions can be watched again from the replay library.

free_resources.title: Sleep Meditations for Wealth & Abundance
free_resources.description: Five free guided bedtime meditations set to music, one for each night, on opening up to receiving and a sense of plenty. They can be played from the page or sent by email one night at a time.

free_resources.title: Grace Note: A Three-Minute Sound Ritual Before You Eat
free_resources.description: A short free listening ritual to use just before a meal. A single tone guides the breath and draws attention into the body so the meal begins with a pause.
